# Data Model: MVP de Diagnósticos de Oportunidades Tecnológicas

**Storage**: PostgreSQL 18 via EF Core 10/Npgsql 10
**Identifiers**: UUID primary keys generated by the API unless a migration defines a provider-native equivalent.
**Time**: Persist audit timestamps in UTC. The diagnosis assessment date is a date-only value.

## Entities

### Client

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| Id | UUID | Primary key |
| CompanyName | text | Required |
| Segment | text | Required, free text |
| ContactName | text | Optional |
| Email | text | Optional |
| Phone | text | Optional |
| Notes | text | Optional |
| CreatedAtUtc | timestamp with time zone | Required |
| UpdatedAtUtc | timestamp with time zone | Required |

A client has many client sectors and diagnoses. This MVP has no client-delete operation. Order client search results by `UpdatedAtUtc` descending. Updating client profile data or one of its sectors updates the parent client's `UpdatedAtUtc`.

### ClientSector

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| Id | UUID | Primary key |
| ClientId | UUID | Required FK to Client |
| Name | text | Required |
| ResponsibleName | text | Optional |
| PeopleCount | integer | Optional |
| CreatedAtUtc / UpdatedAtUtc | timestamp with time zone | Required |

Create a unique key on `(Id, ClientId)` to support composite ownership constraints. Suggested names are UI choices; this table stores only the sector entries the consultant adds. The project does not add a sector-delete workflow.

### Diagnosis

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| Id | UUID | Primary key |
| ClientId | UUID | Required FK to Client |
| Title | text | Required |
| AssessmentDate | date | Required; initially the current local date |
| Context | text | Optional |
| Status | enum/text | `Draft`, `InProgress`, or `Completed`; new diagnoses start as `Draft` |
| ExecutiveSummary | text | Optional editable report content |
| GeneralRecommendations | text | Optional editable report content |
| NextSteps | text | Optional editable report content |
| CreatedAtUtc / UpdatedAtUtc | timestamp with time zone | Required |

Client association may change only while no `SectorAssessment` exists. A completed diagnosis is read-only until the explicit re-open transition changes it to `InProgress`. No diagnosis-delete operation is exposed. Every successful mutation of a diagnosis-owned record also updates this diagnosis's `UpdatedAtUtc` in the same transaction so the home screen reflects its latest work.

Create a unique key on `(Id, ClientId)` to support the sector-assessment composite foreign key.

### DiagnosisObjective

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| DiagnosisId | UUID | Required FK to Diagnosis |
| Code | enum/text | Required objective code |
| IsPrimary | boolean | Required; at most one true row per diagnosis |
| CustomDescription | text | Required only when Code is `Other`; otherwise absent |

Use `(DiagnosisId, Code)` as the primary key. Enforce at most one primary objective with a unique filtered index. The API validates that the selected primary belongs to the submitted objective set. A diagnosis may have no primary before completion; completion requires exactly one.

Objective codes: `ReduceCosts`, `ImproveProductivity`, `ReduceErrorsAndRework`, `ImproveService`, `IncreaseSales`, `IntegrateInformation`, `Other`.

### SectorAssessment

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| Id | UUID | Primary key |
| DiagnosisId | UUID | Required |
| ClientId | UUID | Required ownership key, same as its diagnosis |
| ClientSectorId | UUID | Required, same client as the diagnosis |
| SectorNameSnapshot | text | Required; copied when linked |
| Answer01 … Answer10 | text | Nullable fixed-question responses |
| CreatedAtUtc / UpdatedAtUtc | timestamp with time zone | Required |

Enforce one assessment per `(DiagnosisId, ClientSectorId)`. Use composite foreign keys `(DiagnosisId, ClientId) → Diagnosis(Id, ClientId)` and `(ClientSectorId, ClientId) → ClientSector(Id, ClientId)` so a sector from another client cannot be linked even if a handler is defective. The snapshot preserves the sector name at link time; edits to the client sector affect future assessments only.

Create a unique key on `(Id, DiagnosisId)` for bottleneck ownership constraints.

Question text and order are fixed by the specification and are not stored as editable data. Response progress is computed as the count of answer values with non-whitespace content, from 0 through 10. Saving the answer form replaces its ten values as one explicit operation.

An assessment may be removed only while it has no nonblank answer and no bottleneck. Its sector must still belong to the diagnosis client.

### Bottleneck

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| Id | UUID | Primary key |
| DiagnosisId | UUID | Required |
| SectorAssessmentId | UUID | Required; assessment in the same diagnosis |
| Title | text | Required |
| Description | text | Optional |
| Category | enum/text | Required |
| Impact | integer | Required, 1–5 |
| Frequency | text | Optional free text |
| Evidence | text | Optional; distinct from probable cause |
| ProbableCause | text | Optional; distinct from evidence |
| EstimatedMonthlyHours | numeric | Optional, must be >= 0 |
| Notes | text | Optional |
| CreatedAtUtc / UpdatedAtUtc | timestamp with time zone | Required |

Enforce the assessment relationship with composite FK `(SectorAssessmentId, DiagnosisId) → SectorAssessment(Id, DiagnosisId)`. Deletion is rejected while any opportunity references the bottleneck.

Create a unique key on `(Id, DiagnosisId)` for the opportunity-bottleneck composite relation.

Category codes: `ManualWork`, `Repetition`, `Rework`, `Delay`, `MissingIntegration`, `ScatteredInformation`, `PeopleDependency`, `CommercialProblem`, `Other`.

### Opportunity

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| Id | UUID | Primary key |
| DiagnosisId | UUID | Required |
| PhaseId | UUID | Optional; phase must belong to the same diagnosis |
| Title | text | Required |
| SolutionDescription | text | Optional |
| Type | enum/text | Required |
| ExpectedBenefit | text | Required |
| Impact | integer | Required, 1–5 |
| Effort | integer | Required, 1–5 |
| Urgency | integer | Required, 1–5 |
| Dependencies | text | Optional |
| AiDataNeeds | text | Optional |
| NeedsHumanReview | boolean | Optional |
| CreatedAtUtc / UpdatedAtUtc | timestamp with time zone | Required |

Enforce `(Id, DiagnosisId)` as a unique key for the opportunity-bottleneck composite relation. An opportunity must link to one or more bottlenecks from the same diagnosis; validate the nonempty collection in the API transaction. Remove its join rows when the opportunity itself is deleted.

Priority is derived, not persisted:

```text
priority = (Impact × 2) + Urgency − Effort
minimum = -2; maximum = 14
```

Sort by priority descending, impact descending, effort ascending, then title ascending. Use UUID only as a deterministic final tie-break for duplicate titles. Phase assignment does not affect score or ordering.

Type codes: `ProcessImprovement`, `ExistingTool`, `Integration`, `CustomSoftware`, `Automation`, `AiApplication`.

### OpportunityBottleneck

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| DiagnosisId | UUID | Required ownership key |
| OpportunityId | UUID | Required |
| BottleneckId | UUID | Required |

Composite primary key: `(OpportunityId, BottleneckId)`. Composite foreign keys `(OpportunityId, DiagnosisId) → Opportunity(Id, DiagnosisId)` and `(BottleneckId, DiagnosisId) → Bottleneck(Id, DiagnosisId)` prevent cross-diagnosis links. The API validates at least one relation after every opportunity create/update.

### Phase

| Field | Type | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| Id | UUID | Primary key |
| DiagnosisId | UUID | Required |
| Name | text | Required |
| Description | text | Optional |
| SortOrder | integer | Required, unique within diagnosis |
| CreatedAtUtc / UpdatedAtUtc | timestamp with time zone | Required |

New diagnoses receive three ordinary editable phase rows, ordered as “Melhorias rápidas”, “MVP”, and “Evolução”. Reordering updates the submitted complete order and normalizes positions. An opportunity has zero or one phase; a composite optional FK `(PhaseId, DiagnosisId) → Phase(Id, DiagnosisId)` prevents assignment across diagnoses. Unallocated opportunities remain valid and report after the ordered phases.

Create a unique key on `(Id, DiagnosisId)` for the optional opportunity phase foreign key.

## Relationships

```text
Client 1 ── * ClientSector
Client 1 ── * Diagnosis
Diagnosis 1 ── * DiagnosisObjective
Diagnosis 1 ── * SectorAssessment * ── 1 ClientSector
SectorAssessment 1 ── * Bottleneck
Diagnosis 1 ── * Bottleneck
Diagnosis 1 ── * Opportunity
Opportunity * ── * Bottleneck (OpportunityBottleneck; same diagnosis required)
Diagnosis 1 ── * Phase
Phase 0..1 ── * Opportunity
```

## State and integrity rules

- Draft and in-progress diagnoses may be edited. They may transition between each other or be completed after the completion prerequisites pass.
- Completion is allowed only when a primary selected objective, at least one bottleneck, and at least one opportunity exist. Sector answers and phase assignment are not completion prerequisites.
- A completed diagnosis rejects all content mutations. Reopening changes it to `InProgress`, preserves saved values, and then permits editing. A completed diagnosis cannot transition directly to Draft.
- Changing the diagnosis client is allowed only before the first sector assessment is added.
- A selected sector must belong to the current diagnosis client. A stored assessment keeps its sector-name snapshot.
- Opportunity and bottleneck links are validated against the same diagnosis both at the request boundary and by composite database keys.
- Delete only the explicitly specified bottleneck, opportunity, and eligible sector-assessment records. Client and diagnosis deletion are not supported; no delete endpoint is planned for client sectors or phases.
- The report is a projection over persisted diagnosis data, not a second copy. Client identity fields come from the current client record; assessed sector labels come from their diagnosis snapshots.
- Deletion of an opportunity removes only its opportunity-bottleneck join rows. Deleting a linked bottleneck or an assessment with answers is rejected; do not cascade-delete business data silently.
